#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
const int MAX_N = 250005;
int n, k, mod;
using ll = long long;

ll modPow(ll base, ll exp) {
    ll result = 1;
    base %= mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % mod;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

inline int getLowbit(int x) { return x & -x; }

ll factorial[MAX_N], invFactorial[MAX_N];
ll memo[26][MAX_N];

ll solve(int position, int mask) {
    if (memo[position][mask] != -1) return memo[position][mask];
    
    if (mask == 0) {
        memo[position][mask] = factorial[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < position; ++i) {
            memo[position][mask] = (memo[position][mask] * (k - i)) % mod;
        }
        return memo[position][mask];
    }
    
    memo[position][mask] = 0;
    int submask = mask - getLowbit(mask);
    
    for (int subset = submask; subset > 0; subset = (subset - 1) & submask) {
        memo[position][mask] = (memo[position][mask] + invFactorial[mask - subset] * solve(position + 1, subset)) % mod;
    }
    
    memo[position][mask] = (memo[position][mask] + invFactorial[mask] * solve(position + 1, 0)) % mod;
    return memo[position][mask];
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> n >> k >> mod;
    ll total = modPow(k, n);
    
    if (n % 2 == 1) {
        cout << total << '\n';
        return 0;
    }
    
    factorial[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) factorial[i] = factorial[i-1] * i % mod;
    
    invFactorial[n] = modPow(factorial[n], mod - 2);
    for (int i = n; i >= 1; --i) {
        invFactorial[i-1] = invFactorial[i] * i % mod;
    }
    
    memset(memo, -1, sizeof(memo));
    ll subtract = solve(0, n);
    ll result = (total - subtract + mod) % mod;
    cout << result << '\n';
    
    return 0;
}
